title: Horizontal compatibility of the normalized ordinary geometric tensor components
statement:
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)
  (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)


variable (μ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M N : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n)),
  (O.inverseImage n).modules.obj (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} J (B n) M N) ≅
    ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} J' (O.coefficients n)
      ((O.inverseImage n).modules.obj M) ((O.inverseImage n).modules.obj N))


@[irreducible] def geometricTensorComponent (n : ℕ) (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n).obj
        (O.pull.obj (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
          (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) M N)) ≅
      (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n).obj
        (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J')
          (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)
          (O.pull.obj M) (O.pull.obj N)) := by
  let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients (O.coefficients n)
  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (O.coefficients n)
  exact (O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).app _ ≪≫
    (O.inverseImage n).modules.mapIso (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ n M N) ≪≫
    μ n ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M)
      ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj N) ≪≫
    CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorIso
      ((O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).app M).symm
      ((O.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).app N).symm ≪≫
    (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n
      (O.pull.obj M) (O.pull.obj N)).symm


theorem geometricTensorComponent_horizontal [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, InverseTensorPure.{c, v, r} J J' uInv
      (B n) (O.coefficients n) (O.inverseImage n) (μ n))
    (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      (transition.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition h).app
          (O.pull.obj (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
            (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) M N)) ≫
        (res.{c, v, max c v r}
          (coefficientMap.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition h)).map
          (geometricTensorComponent.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O μ n M N).hom =
      (geometricTensorComponent.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet O μ m M N).hom ≫
        (transition.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition h).app
          (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J')
            (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)
            (O.pull.obj M) (O.pull.obj N))

proof.text: Use the existing section casts for evaluation and the actual transition formula. Naturality of tensorSection under presheaf restriction and the pure normalization of ordinaryEvaluationTensor show that the evaluated horizontal tensor map takes a pure tensor to the tensor of the two horizontal restrictions.

Compose ordinaryPullEvaluation with moduleUnderlying to identify the underlying sheaf of each evaluated pullback with uInv of the original evaluated underlying sheaf. Apply ordinaryPullTransition, restrictionPullback_underlying and naturality of moduleUnderlying to prove horizontal_normalization. Hence transporting any generalized section commutes with the actual horizontal map (imageMap_transition).

For any generalized pair and its pure tensor, expand the fixed geometricTensorComponent, cancel the evaluation isomorphism, use naturality of moduleUnderlying and apply the assumed InverseTensorPure equation. Tensor morphisms act componentwise on pure sections, giving component_pure. Finite product preservation supplies a generalized pair above any two target sections. The ordinary tensor hom extensionality theorem, after conjugating by geometricTensorComponent and ordinaryEvaluationTensor, then proves component_hom_ext.

Apply component_hom_ext to the two horizontal composites. Restrict the source generalized pair and its pure tensor horizontally. The evaluated pure transition formula shows they still satisfy the pure relation. On the left use imageMap_transition and component_pure at the lower level. On the right use component_pure at the upper level, followed by the target pure transition formula and imageMap_transition for both operands. The resulting sections agree; cancel the target evaluation isomorphism. This proves the original horizontal equation without new hypotheses or intermediate holes.
